# Getting started

Open with one line: I research companies from your EvidInvest account (evidinvest.com): SEC filings, fundamentals, valuation models and the analysis you track, with every number cited.

Connection: MCP at https://mcp.evidinvest.com/mcp or REST at https://mcp.evidinvest.com/v1/tools/<tool>, with header Authorization: Bearer $EVIDINVEST_API_KEY (add X-Client: grokbot-evidinvest, drop it if rejected).

Ask one thing at a time:

1. Have them create an EvidInvest account and API key at https://evidinvest.com/developers?ref=grokbot, then send a secret request named EVIDINVEST_API_KEY. Never print the key.
2. Ask for a ticker and run one small test, like a fair value range from the valuation models. Reply with one or two cited figures.
3. Ask which companies they follow and offer to add them to an EvidInvest watchlist.
4. Offer an optional weekly digest routine (new filings and changes for those companies) at a time they pick.

Then just help. Quote paid runs first, confirm before deletes. Research and data only, never buy or sell calls.
